title: Error-Server
description: Server-like mechanics for singleplayer and Essential multiplayer.
body:
⚠️ This mod is currently in active development. (Polish Version)
# Error Server

Bring multiplayer server mechanics into your singleplayer world or Essential multiplayer sessions.

## Features

### Economy

* Money system
* Coin system
* 100 Money = 1 Coin
* Buy and sell items
* `/money`
* `/coins`
* `/sell all`

### Shop

* Clickable GUI shop
* Categories:

  * Building Blocks
  * Wood
  * Food
  * Mob Drops
  * Ores
  * Farming
* Buy and sell items directly from GUI
* Quantity selector

### Auction House

* `/ah`
* Sell items to other players
* Buy items from other players
* Money and Coin listings

### Ranks

* Owner
* Admin
* Mod
* Support
* VIP
* Gracz

Decorated chat prefixes and permission hierarchy.

### Kits

Starter Kit:

* Green leather armor
* Stone tools
* 32 food
* 10 minute cooldown

VIP Kit:

* Full iron armor
* Iron tools
* Shield
* 64 food
* 10 minute cooldown

### Server Features

* Spawn system
* `/spawn`
* `/setspawn`
* Statistics system
* Playtime tracking
* Decorated scoreboard
* Online player counter
* Rank display
* Economy display

### Essential Multiplayer Support

Works in:

* Singleplayer
* LAN Worlds
* Essential Multiplayer Sessions

## Commands

```txt
/shop
/sell all

/ah
/ah wystaw <amount> <price>
/ah wystawcoiny <amount> <price>
/ah kup <id>

/kit starter
/kit vip

/spawn
/setspawn

/stats
/money
/coins
/coins convert <money>

/rank <player> <rank>
```

## Version

```txt
Minecraft: 1.20.1
Loader: Fabric
Requires: Fabric API
```
